premise: In a rain-soaked near-future harbor city, a night courier delivers sealed packages that each hold one impossible object. Every episode is one delivery and one small mystery, resolved in under a minute.

character.name: Kai
character.description: a lean courier in her late twenties with a short black undercut, a scar through her left eyebrow, a weathered olive-green hooded rain jacket with a glowing amber strip on the collar, fingerless black gloves, and a battered silver delivery case strapped to her back
character.voice: calm, low, dry humor, speaks in short lines

world: Neon-lit harbor city at night: wet streets, cargo cranes, floating market stalls, tram cables humming overhead, constant light rain.
visualStyle: cinematic 35mm look, anamorphic lens flares, teal-and-amber color grade, shallow depth of field, volumetric fog, rain catching neon light
audioStyle: rain ambience, distant tram bells, low synth drone; dialogue only from Kai, one or two short lines per scene
tone: mysterious, warm, quietly funny; never gory, never political, no real brands or real people
rules: Every episode is fiction; no health, finance or legal advice.
Kai appears in every scene and is described with the exact character description.
Each episode introduces one new impossible object and one new recipient.
End on a small twist or reveal, then one call to action to follow for the next delivery.

tts.note: Free engine narration (Edge TTS), first person as Kai.
